title: Add 'urgent' priority ranked above high and reject unknown priorities
evidence: var/log/dev.log: ticket id 3 stored with priority 'urgent' (app.INFO 'Ticket created')
observed: POST /api/tickets accepts any string as priority. 'urgent' was stored as-is, but stats and the dashboard only know low, normal and high, so urgent tickets drop out of every filter.
expected: The allowed priorities are low, normal, high and urgent, with urgent ranked above high. Any other value is rejected with a validation error and not stored. Stats and filters include urgent.
